name: Germany
notes: Depth: seed. Scope: national level in every layer (Bundestag, parties, alliances, unions, economists, commentators, wealthy supporters), the 16 Länder as a register, and one sampled Landtag (Berlin). First pass R001 and second pass R002 (2026-10-20): Bundestag motions and bills 2010-2026 with their named sponsors (harvest H0001-H0008), party programmes, the alliance 'Vermögen besteuern jetzt' (22 signatories plus 12 joiners), union and NGO statements, DIW and taz commentary, taxmenow and earlier millionaires' appeals. R002 added the 2022 roll call, debate speakers, the 2021 hearing, three Landtage, the 2021 open letter and 2011 appeals. Not done: BSW (bsw-vg.de refuses connections from this environment), the 2013 roll call, full signatory lists, European Parliament, other Landtage and Länder governments, most media, faith bodies, municipalities (the Länder register is the lowest level loaded). The Left's own site (die-linke.de) answers 403 even to a browser, so its programme was read from an easy-read edition.

polls.question: Reintroducing the wealth tax: a levy on private persons and companies on wealth above EUR 1 million
